Calculate Competing-Risk Dropout Incidence

Source: R/f_design_plan_survival.R
dot-getDropoutIncidence.Rd

Calculates the probability of dropout before an event by a follow-up time, for exponential dropout and exponential or piecewise exponential event times.

Usage

.getDropoutIncidence(time, piecewiseLambda, piecewiseSurvivalTime, phi)

Arguments

time

Vector of follow-up times since enrollment. Negative times give zero incidence; missing times remain missing.

piecewiseLambda

Normalized nonnegative event hazards, one per interval.

piecewiseSurvivalTime

Normalized interval start times, starting at zero. Ignored when there is a single event hazard.

phi

Nonnegative exponential dropout hazard.

Value

A numeric vector of dropout incidences, with one entry per time.

Details

Integrates the dropout hazard times joint event-free and dropout-free survival analytically over the event-hazard intervals. Inputs are normalized by the survival model before this internal helper is called.
